caveat: Cells with no first returns are nodata; 36 of 1156 grid cells are empty. Point classes 1,2,7,12 lack a high-vegetation class.
citation: Coops et al. 2016, A forest structure habitat index based on airborne laser scanning data, Ecological Indicators 67:346-357, doi:10.1016/j.ecolind.2016.02.057
method: First-return points within AOI, normalized with the FEMIC 1 m DEM, binned to 30 m cells; P95, cover > 1.37 m, SD of heights > 1.37 m.
